findings.issue: Stale registry snapshots override newer canonical or freshly extracted facts.
findings.disposition: Fixed: compare source checkpoints; use retained snapshots only as fallback.

findings.issue: Concurrent generation publishes older snapshots after newer ones.
findings.disposition: Fixed: lock publication before baseline/source reads and staged writes.

findings.issue: Explicit generation bypasses known conflicting ticket binding.
findings.disposition: Fixed: enforce exact ticket/store ownership for explicit selectors and aliases.

findings.issue: Codex child start evidence is discarded until stop callback.
findings.disposition: Fixed: persist child-start recovery work with native parent identity before stop.

findings.issue: Failed source reads evade per-pass byte budget.
findings.disposition: Fixed: charge failed source attempts against bounded reconciliation work.

findings.issue: Repeated placeholder substitution corrupts valid escaped plugin paths.
findings.disposition: Fixed: substitute template placeholders once, preserving escaped paths.

findings.issue: Native receive timeout does not bound blocked stdin.
findings.disposition: Fixed: bound stdin reads and close blocked input on cancellation.

findings.issue: Incompatible binary replacement strands active lifecycle hooks.
findings.disposition: Fixed: preflight native protocol compatibility and roll back partial replacement.

findings.issue: Public manual direct and PowerShell setup lacks lifecycle integration.
findings.disposition: Fixed: connect manual Unix/PowerShell setup to lifecycle installation and binding checks.

findings.issue: Reported snapshot cutoff precedes source reads and can misstate captured boundary.
findings.disposition: Fixed: report reconciliation completion and successful owner-read checkpoints without a common as-of claim.

findings.issue: Unrelated unassigned sessions consume ticket refresh budget and leak into ticket report.
findings.disposition: Fixed: scope ticket work/budgets to proven owners and redact unrelated session IDs.

findings.issue: Child recovery lacks fair bounded continuation for known OpenCode pages and failed Codex metadata queues.
findings.disposition: Fixed: persist recovery cursors, rotate work fairly and retain failures. Discovered during re-review.
